payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Boris, Ciara, Drew, Octavio, Tara, Vicente

payload.content: All - I'm Drew with strong frontend/documentation skills. ISSUE-0002 (critical priority) tasks align well with my expertise. Planning to claim one of the ISSUE-0002 tasks (implement/review/test) unless someone else has strong preference for them.

Hi all - Boris here. I have strong documentation skills and 4h availability. ISSUE-0002 tasks (especially review/test) look like good matches for my skills with reasonable costs. Drew, since you're also interested in ISSUE-0002, perhaps we can coordinate - I'm flexible between review or test tasks. Happy to defer to your preference and take whichever ISSUE-0002 task you don't want, or look at other options if needed.

Update: Given my 4h availability and cost analysis, ISSUE-0002::review (cost 3.77, 2h effort) would be my optimal choice. ISSUE-0002::test (cost 5.28, 2.8h effort) is also feasible. The ISSUE-0001 tasks are very cost-inefficient for me (16-40 cost range). Drew - would you prefer implement, review, or test for ISSUE-0002? Others - any concerns with me taking ISSUE-0002::review?

Hi team - Tara here. I have strong mobile-development skills (0.94) and 7h availability. ISSUE-0001 tasks are an excellent match for my expertise with very reasonable costs (1.54-3.84). Since Drew and Boris are better suited for the critical ISSUE-0002 frontend/documentation tasks, I'm planning to claim one of the ISSUE-0001 tasks. I'm most efficient at triage (1.54 cost, 1.6h) and docs (1.92 cost, 2h), but can handle any ISSUE-0001 task well. Any preferences from others on ISSUE-0001 tasks before I commit?

Thanks for sharing your cost analyses! I see Octavio and Ciara have excellent cost efficiency on ISSUE-0001 tasks (0.12-0.79 range vs my 1.54-3.84). For team optimization, it makes sense for you both to prioritize ISSUE-0001 tasks. I'll pivot to see what other options might work best - perhaps I can help with coordination or look at remaining tasks once others have made their selections. Vicente, what's your availability and skill alignment looking like?

Hi team - Ciara here. I have documentation (0.87) and frontend (0.66) skills with 6h availability. While I have good cost efficiency on ISSUE-0001 tasks, my skills actually align better with ISSUE-0002's documentation/frontend focus. ISSUE-0002::review (cost 2.31, 2h effort) is my optimal choice. Drew/Boris - since you're both interested in ISSUE-0002 tasks, how should we coordinate? I'm flexible but ISSUE-0002::review seems like the best fit for my skillset.

Team - following up on ISSUE-0002 coordination: Drew mentioned wanting one of implement/review/test, Boris prefers review (3.77 cost), and I'm optimal at review (2.31 cost). To avoid conflicts and optimize team scoring, perhaps we can sort this out: Drew - what's your preference among implement/review/test? Boris and I both prefer review but I have slightly better cost efficiency. Happy to defer if needed, or we can find another arrangement that maximizes our joint score.

Team - Vicente here. I have strong mobile-development skills (0.96) and 9h availability. ISSUE-0001 tasks are an excellent match for me with costs of 1.51-3.78. Given the coordination discussions, I'm planning to take ISSUE-0001::triage (1.51 cost, 1.6h effort) for optimal efficiency. This allows others with frontend/documentation skills to focus on the critical ISSUE-0002 tasks. Any concerns with this approach?

Hi team - Octavio here. I have strong mobile-development skills (0.84) and 9h availability. Looking at the cost analysis, ISSUE-0001 tasks are extremely efficient for me (costs 1.71-4.28), while ISSUE-0002 tasks are very expensive (20-40 cost) due to skill mismatch.

Given the coordination discussions, I see:
- Vicente is taking ISSUE-0001::triage (excellent choice)
- Tara is flexible on ISSUE-0001 tasks
- Drew, Boris, Ciara are coordinating on ISSUE-0002 tasks

For optimal team scoring, I'm planning to take ISSUE-0001::implement (4.28 cost, 4h effort) since it's the highest priority ISSUE-0001 task and I have excellent efficiency. This leaves the remaining ISSUE-0001 tasks (review, test, docs) for Tara or others who might need them.

Drew/Boris/Ciara - please proceed with your ISSUE-0002 coordination. I'll commit to ISSUE-0001::implement unless anyone has concerns or alternative suggestions for better team optimization.

Team - updating my ISSUE-0002 preference: I'll take ISSUE-0002::review (2.16 cost, 2h effort) since it's optimal for my frontend/documentation skills and resolves the coordination conflict between Boris and Ciara. This leaves ISSUE-0002::implement and ISSUE-0002::test available for others. Boris - you can take ISSUE-0002::test if you'd like, or look at other options. Ciara - you're now free to take ISSUE-0002::implement or explore other tasks. Vicente and I have the ISSUE-0001 tasks well covered with our mobile-dev skills.

Team - Boris updating my position: With Drew taking ISSUE-0002::review, I'll commit to ISSUE-0002::test (5.28 cost, 2.8h effort) since it's still feasible within my 4h availability and much better than any ISSUE-0001 options for me. This gives us good coverage on the critical ISSUE-0002 tasks. Ciara - you could take ISSUE-0002::implement if that works for your skills, or look at remaining ISSUE-0001 tasks. Octavio/Vicente/Tara - you three have the ISSUE-0001 tasks well optimized with your mobile-dev expertise. Any final coordination needed before we move to execution? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Ciara - following up on my last message: Since you have good frontend/documentation skills and 6h availability, ISSUE-0002::implement (4h effort) could be a great fit for you to complete our ISSUE-0002 coverage. Alternatively, if you prefer ISSUE-0001 tasks, there are still review, test, and docs available there. What's your preference for final coordination before execution? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi team - Tara here. Looking at the current coordination state:

ISSUE-0001 assignments so far:
- Vicente: triage (1.51 cost)
- Octavio: implement (4.28 cost)

ISSUE-0002 assignments so far:
- Drew: review (2.16 cost)
- Boris: test (5.28 cost)

Remaining tasks:
ISSUE-0001: review, test, docs
ISSUE-0002: implement

Since I have strong mobile-dev skills and good efficiency on ISSUE-0001 tasks (1.54-3.84 cost), I'll take ISSUE-0001::docs (1.92 cost, 2h effort). This gives us good coverage on documentation while staying in my optimal skill area.

Ciara - you're left with the choice between ISSUE-0002::implement (4h effort, critical priority) or any remaining ISSUE-0001 tasks. Given your frontend/documentation skills, ISSUE-0002::implement seems like the better fit for team optimization.

Any final concerns before we execute?

Update: Actually, looking more carefully at the remaining ISSUE-0001 tasks and my skills:

ISSUE-0001::docs (1.92 cost, 2h, documentation tags) - matches my documentation skill (0.71)
ISSUE-0001::review (1.92 cost, 2h, mobile-development tags) - matches my mobile-dev skill (0.94)

Since I have stronger mobile-dev skills (0.94) than documentation (0.71), I'll take ISSUE-0001::review instead for better efficiency and skill utilization. This still leaves ISSUE-0001::docs available if anyone else needs it.

Final plan:
- Me: ISSUE-0001::review
- Vicente: ISSUE-0001::triage  
- Octavio: ISSUE-0001::implement
- Drew: ISSUE-0002::review
- Boris: ISSUE-0002::test
- Ciara: ISSUE-0002::implement (pending confirmation)

This gives us complete coverage on both issues with optimal skill matching. Sound good?

Team - Octavio confirming my assignment: I'm set on ISSUE-0001::implement (4.28 cost, 4h effort) which is optimal for my mobile-dev skills. Current state looks excellent for team optimization:

ISSUE-0001: Complete coverage (Vicente-triage, Octavio-implement, Tara-review)
ISSUE-0002: 2/3 assigned (Drew-review, Boris-test), Ciara pending for implement

All assignments show strong skill matching and cost efficiency. Ready to execute when Ciara confirms her choice. Great coordination everyone!

Team - Octavio here. Confirming I'm ready to execute on ISSUE-0001::implement. Current assignments appear complete:

ISSUE-0001 coverage: Vicente(triage), Octavio(implement), Tara(review) ✓
ISSUE-0002 coverage: Drew(review), Boris(test), Ciara(implement) ✓

All tasks assigned with excellent skill matching. Is everyone ready to move to execution phase?

Team - Boris here. Confirming my assignment to ISSUE-0002::test. The coordination looks excellent:

✓ ISSUE-0001: Complete coverage with optimal mobile-dev skill matching
✓ ISSUE-0002: Complete coverage with frontend/documentation skill matching

All assignments show strong cost efficiency and no conflicts. Ready to execute on ISSUE-0002::test (5.28 cost, 2.8h effort, within my 4h availability).

Let's move to execution!

Hi team - Tara confirming my final position. I'm ready to execute on ISSUE-0001::review (1.92 cost, 2h effort) which is optimal for my mobile-development skills and well within my 7h availability.

The coordination looks excellent - we have complete coverage on both issues with strong skill matching across the board. Ready to move to execution phase!

Team - Ciara confirming final coordination. I'm ready to execute on ISSUE-0002::implement (4.62 cost, 4h effort) which aligns well with my frontend/documentation skills and fits within my 6h availability.

✓ ISSUE-0002: Complete coverage (Drew-review, Boris-test, Ciara-implement)

Team - Octavio confirming final assignment coordination. I'm set on ISSUE-0001::implement (4.28 cost, 4h effort) which maximizes my mobile-development skills and fits perfectly within my 9h availability.
